top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a prediction (Kane-Mele Z2 insulator) followed by an unambiguous measurement (quantized helical edge conductance in HgTe wells by Molenkamp), stable for about two decades and confirmed by independent transport, ARPES and microscopy probes. A citation restricted to the Z2 state and its first observation is bounded and distinct from the 2016 topological-phase prize. The Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang gap is a real allocation weakness that I accept as a cost, but it can be stated openly in the citation. P002 is second because its theory and experiment concern the same model, though seven years of maturity and an unsettled pairing mechanism make it less ready; P003 is third for its clean two-name credit, but priority among early lattice-clock proposals is not fully documented in the record. An award is preferable to no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; Goran Johansson is a Chalmers colleague, but he is not credited in any proposal, and my microscopy work is only a general field overlap with moire and topological materials
